about.headline:
We place stories on your table.
"Finedining Theater" — an experiential content brand that shares life's stories through food and art.
about.lead:
We believe everyone carries their own story
in a single meal.
about.body:
For some, it's the pork cutlet their father fried for thirty years.
For some, it's the kimbap their mother packed for them.
For some, it's a bowl of rice eaten after a long day's work.
These meals hold the memory of a life.
Finedining Theater
is an experiential content company that shares life's stories through food and art.
We create performances, study food, meet people,
and place their stories on a new table.
And at that table, we hope people can sit face to face again.
about.mission:
We warmly connect people
by sharing life's stories through food and art.
about.values.story.title: We listen to a person's life.
about.values.story.body: Our stories begin in people's lives and memories.
about.values.food.title: We study the tastes held in memory.
about.values.food.body: We bring the time and stories inside food back to today's table.
about.values.together.title: We sit face to face again.
about.values.together.body: Through art and food, we connect people.
about.products.experience.title: Experience content that joins stories and food
about.products.experience.body: We combine performance IP with food to create content that lets people experience a life through story and cuisine.
about.products.cultural.title: A table for companies and organizations
about.products.cultural.body: We create cultural experiences where companies and institutions watch a performance, share a meal, and meet each other in a new way.
about.products.local.title: Content that meets local life
about.products.local.body: We discover the stories that remain in a region's people, food, and places, and create content that can only be experienced there.
about.products.kfood.title: Korean life on the world's table
about.products.kfood.body: We develop the lives and stories of Koreans held in food into performances and experience content to share with more people.
about.products.custom.title: Your story on a new table
about.products.custom.body: We discover the stories of people and spaces held by companies, institutions, and regions, and turn them into tailored experience content.
about.closing:
With a good meal full of life's stories,
we'd like to sit face to face with you again.
about.history.1: We place stories on your table. Finedining Theater is a distribution platform for experience content that combines performance IP and food. Company history: 2026 selected for the Arts Management Support Center's early-stage startup support program. 2026 selected as a short-term resident organization at Art Korea Lab. 2025 Grand Prize at the startup competition of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and the Arts Management Support Center. 2025 nominated for the Seoul Arts Award by the Seoul Foundation for Arts and Culture. 2024 selected for the ACC Asia Contents creation program: "Fine Dining". Our content: Fine Dining, a gastronomic performance featuring a Western-style pork cutlet. Bread, House (빵, 집), a performance linking the anxiety that ferments in the younger generation with baking. Ms. Park Kyung-ok Is Nowhere and Everywhere (박경옥씨는 어디에도 없고, 어디에나 있다), a performance about loss and recovery. BRUNCH-RUN (브RUN치), a wellness program combining running and food. Table of Memory (기억의 식탁), a social dining program combining art and food. Highlights: Grand Prize at the 2025 Arts Industry Academy startup competition. 700+ cumulative paying audience members. 9.8 audience rating (every performance sold out). Seoul Arts Award nominee (artistic merit recognized at Banjul, December 2025).
about.history.2: A good meal full of life's stories. We empathize through performance, experience through food, and connect through conversation. #comfort #empathy #generations together
about.history.3: Finedining Theater warmly connects people. Performance: we experience the same story together. Gastronomy: we share the same food. Conversation: we expand our experiences into each other's stories. Private Theater Restaurant: with content you can only experience at Finedining Theater, we create time to connect and talk with one another.
